Definition: Ramah, the name of a grandson of Ham, and of a place (perhaps founded by him)
BiblicalUsage: Raamah = "horse's mane"; n pr m; 1) son of Cush and father of Sheba and Dedan; n pr loc; 2) a home of traders
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
